name: Persuasion
summary: Influence with tact and social grace.
description: When you attempt to influence someone or a group of people with tact, social graces, or good nature, the GM might ask you to make a Charisma (Persuasion) check.
typicalUses: Diplomacy, negotiation, appeals to reason or friendship.
exampleChecks: Broker peace; convince a merchant to lower a price; sway a council.
